name: Correspondent Banking and Joint Ventures in Proliferation Financing
description: Proliferation-linked entities may reach the international financial system via correspondent relationships, nested accounts or joint ventures that mask the involvement of restricted parties. Respondent due diligence and payment-message review are the main tools for detecting this exposure.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance on Counter Proliferation Financing (2018)
Wolfsberg Group, Correspondent Banking Due Diligence Questionnaire (CBDDQ)
FATF, Guidance on Correspondent Banking Services (2016)

indicators.name: Respondent bank with presence or business in jurisdictions of proliferation concern
indicators.canon: Respondent bank with presence or business in jurisdictions of proliferation concern
indicators.desc: Respondent holds accounts or branches in higher-risk countries without strong controls.
indicators.ctx: Respondent holds accounts or branches in higher-risk countries without strong controls.
indicators.fp: Global banks operate in many markets.

indicators.name: Payments that include references to designated or restricted entities
indicators.canon: Payments that include references to designated or restricted entities
indicators.desc: Payment messages show names, addresses or vessels linked to restricted lists.
indicators.ctx: Payment messages show names, addresses or vessels linked to restricted lists.
indicators.fp: Partial name matches generate false hits.

indicators.name: Nested relationships with unidentified downstream banks
indicators.canon: Nested relationships with unidentified downstream banks
indicators.desc: Respondent processes payments for other banks without disclosure.
indicators.ctx: Respondent processes payments for other banks without disclosure.
indicators.fp: Some nested arrangements are legitimate and permitted.

indicators.name: Joint venture with opaque ownership involving state-affiliated partner in higher-risk country
indicators.canon: Beneficial owner or controller cannot be identified
indicators.desc: Ownership or governance is opaque and no natural person who owns or controls the entity can be identified after reasonable effort.
indicators.ctx: Joint venture entity has partners or beneficial owners that cannot be verified.
indicators.fp: State partners are common in JV structures.

indicators.name: Payments with missing, truncated or inconsistent ordering or beneficiary information
indicators.canon: Missing, incomplete or placeholder originator and beneficiary information
indicators.desc: Payment messages omit, truncate or use generic placeholder data for originator or beneficiary details.
indicators.ctx: Messages omit key details or show inconsistent data.

indicators.name: Trade-related payments through correspondent for goods of proliferation concern
indicators.canon: Trade-related payments through correspondent for goods of proliferation concern
indicators.desc: Payments relate to goods on control lists or to parties on alerts.
indicators.ctx: Payments relate to goods on control lists or to parties on alerts.
indicators.fp: Generic words can create false hits.

indicators.name: Sudden increase in volume through a respondent or dormant account reactivation
indicators.canon: Sudden large increase in transaction volume
indicators.desc: Transaction volume or value rises abruptly well beyond historical levels, including through a respondent or reactivated account.
indicators.ctx: Significant, unexplained increase in activity from a respondent.

indicators.name: Respondent processing for front companies of concern in prior reports
indicators.canon: Respondent processing for front companies of concern in prior reports
indicators.desc: Respondent's customers appear in prior internal or external reports.
indicators.ctx: Respondent's customers appear in prior internal or external reports.
